subject: Approval request: cross-region private offer — blended rev-share & invoice netting (Helios.ai)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:12:34 -0700
Subject: Approval request: cross-region private offer — blended rev-share & invoice netting (Helios.ai)

Hi team,

Quick ask: need exec clearance on a cross-region private offer for Helios.ai by EOD Friday (2025-08-23). Key facts below — asking for explicit signoff (rev/share + invoice netting) because this deviates from our standard marketplace controls.

Deal snapshot
- Account: Helios.ai (AI platform)
- ARR (first-year committed): $1.2M
- Offer: Private listing across AWS (us-east-1) and GCP (us-central1) with a single invoice flow
- Commercial ask: 10% customer discount off list + blended rev-share of 20% (across both clouds) instead of standard 25%
- Special term requested by customer: allow invoice netting (Helios wants marketplace credits to be netted against Redwood invoices across regions to simplify their procurement)

Why this is an exception
- Marketplace rev-share is typically per-cloud and not blended. Netting complicates revenue recognition and marketplace payout flows.
- Customer is insistent on one consolidated commercial treatment due to their internal billing constraints and multi-region deployment.

Attachments: Helios-PO-draft.pdf, revshare-model.xlsx, SOW-Helios-v3.docx (incl. pricing/usage buckets).

Ask
1) Approve blended rev-share of 20% (fixed for first 12 months).
2) Approve invoice netting (one-off pilot for first 12 months), with a cap on nettable credits (proposed $150,000).
3) If approved, authorize Legal to include netting clause & Finance to accept revenue recognition approach; ops to prepare marketplace listing notes and billing routing.

Why now
- Customer has signalled willingness to sign the private offer once we confirm these two items. Close window: they want execution by next week to align Q4 procurement.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick sync this afternoon if useful.

—Marissa
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: cross-region private offer — blended rev-share & invoice netting (Helios.ai)

Marissa — thanks for the summary. A few clarifying items before I escalate to exec sign-off:

1) Netting rationale: can you capture why Helios cannot accept per-cloud invoicing? Is this a procurement policy or an internal accounting constraint?
2) Unit economics: open question on margin impact across clouds (AWS vs GCP list pricing / marketplace fees). Please call out expected gross margin delta under the blended 20% rev-share vs standard 25%.
3) Alternatives: would Helios accept a one-time marketplace credit (stageable on our side) instead of netting? That would be simpler operationally.
4) Risk controls: recommend we cap exposure (you proposed $150k) + require a 12-month pilot and a rollback clause if usage patterns materially change.

If Finance (Stephanie) and Legal (Monica) can thumbs-up the approach, I will present to Evelyn for final signoff. Please push the revshare-model.xlsx with the margin tab filled out.

-Karthik
Head of Deal Desk

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: cross-region private offer — blended rev-share & invoice netting (Helios.ai)

Karthik / Marissa — reviewed the model you shared and inserted a short finance impact memo (attached: finance-impact-notes.pdf). Summary:

- Margin impact: Blended rev-share at 20% vs 25% increases cost of revenue by ~5 percentage points on committed ARR, reducing first-year gross margin by ~2400 basis points on the contracted book (details in revshare-model.xlsx).
- Revenue recognition: Invoice netting across marketplace credits will require a clear offset schedule; we should classify nettable credits as contra-revenue for GAAP purposes and document in the SOW.
- Suggested changes: 1) cap nettable credits to $150,000 total for the 12-month pilot, 2) require a monthly usage report from Helios for reconciliation, 3) include a rollback clause after 12 months.

Finance can support a one-time deviation provided we get Evelyn's exec signoff on policy exception and Legal signs the netting language. If Evelyn approves, we will prepare the revenue recognition memo for accounting and notify Revenue Ops.

- Stephanie
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 15:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: cross-region private offer — blended rev-share & invoice netting (Helios.ai)

Team — reviewed the deal and the Finance memo. I approve the following one-time exception for Helios.ai:

1) Blended rev-share of 20% for the first 12 months (fixed).
2) Invoice netting permitted for a 12-month pilot only, with a $150,000 cap on nettable credits.
3) Legal to add explicit netting language in the SOW and include rollback/termination triggers tied to usage or reconciliation failures.
4) Revenue Ops to create a reconciliation cadence (monthly) and Finance to prepare formal revenue recognition guidance.

Conditions: Monica (Legal), please prepare the redline to the PO/SOW with netting language and a clear tax/withholding section. Jonas (Sales Ops), work with Experiments/Billing to ensure marketplace routing is feasible for a blended listing and flag any technical constraints. Karthik, document this as an approved policy exception in Deal Desk tracker and tag the HubSpot deal record (I see HLX-2025-0047).

Marissa — you have my approval to communicate this to Helios and proceed to execution once Legal sends the redline. Keep me copied on the final DocuSign.

—Evelyn
VP, Revenue — Redwood Inference
